title: Field console
description: A full-width field of fine contours bends under a direct drag, with one orange trace revealing its motion.
useCase: Expressive two-axis controls for synthesis, motion studies and procedural visual modulation.
interaction: Drag the wave field or hold arrow keys; adjust flow, spread and grain.
reducedMotion: The wave clock stops and release returns immediately; manual XY and parameter changes still redraw.
limitations: Procedural visual waves, without audio synthesis, frequency analysis or device communication.
look: Dark slate-teal field of pale stacked wave contours with one orange trace, above a control bar holding a round pause button and three orange sliders.
motion: Wave lines drift continuously at a flow-set speed; the dragged XY point sets frequency (right is higher) and amplitude (up is taller), easing back to centre on release.
adapt: `render` draws 28 canvas polylines from `frequency`, `amp` and `flow`, `spread` and `grain` in `parameters`; `update` writes the XY `target` and `1 - Math.exp(-dt * 20)` eases `current` toward it. Recolour the `#ff784c` trace and remap `target` to your own controls.
